items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: there’s a Dixieland section in there that Elmer Bernstein had in the film. He cut the entire thing out.

ctx.x: But he could tell by looking at it.

He could tell by hearing it. You know we rehearsed the whole thing. He couldn’t read music but he must have had this second sense of the whole picture. For instance you know my CD “On the Wild Side” I recorded “Walk on the Wild Side” the whole suite. I wrote that for Buddy. And he played it but he never got to record it before he died. And when I brought it into him there’s a Dixieland section in there that Elmer Bernstein had in the film. He cut the entire thing out. And I was pissed. But it works that way and…
Did you ever write a Buddy Rich chart that didn’t have a drum solo that he said, “Okay we’ve got to put in a drum solo.”
